name: Amdocs
description: Amdocs offers enterprise BSS/OSS solutions with CPQ capabilities, competing directly with Skyvera's Salesforce-native platform for telecom operators.
strengths: Established market presence with deep telecom industry relationships and 300+ operator customers
Comprehensive end-to-end BSS ecosystem beyond CPQ including billing, order management, and revenue assurance
Strong professional services and implementation support network globally
weaknesses: Complex, non-Salesforce-native architecture requiring extensive customization and integration work
Higher total cost of ownership with lengthy implementation cycles compared to cloud-native solutions
Legacy technology stack limits agility in rapidly evolving 5G and edge computing service monetization

name: NetCracker
description: NetCracker (part of NEC) provides unified CPQ and BSS platforms for telecoms while also competing with Liberty Global's service offerings in broadband and mobile markets.
strengths: Strong embedded CPQ functionality within broader BSS/OSS suite with native telecom domain models
Advanced machine learning capabilities for pricing optimization and revenue management
Proven scalability with major European operators including multi-country deployments
weaknesses: Not natively built on Salesforce, requiring additional middleware and integration complexity
Longer sales cycles and higher implementation costs than lightweight Salesforce-based solutions
Steeper learning curve and lower adoption rates among sales teams compared to Salesforce-native CPQ tools
